source.title: ISS Droplet Combustion Experiments - Uncertainties in Droplet Sizes and Burning Rates

limitations: Typical literature values are not per-row PSI-69 uncertainty budgets.
Shaw and Yu analyze instantaneous local-polynomial rates; PSI K is an average fit.
The 1.96 conversion and normal perturbations are working sensitivity assumptions.
Diameter, K, and endpoint errors may be correlated; independence is only an approximation.
Uncertainty can be larger near ignition and extinction.
Scenario ranges are not confidence intervals and do not change replication status.

residual_qc.interpretation: Coverage is endpoint consistency under a scenario, not proof that a row is correct
